Synthetic Kiro projects (no sample copied):

- `issue-triage`: Kiro's 2026 style — a Glossary, `WHEN x, THE Term SHALL y`, indented sub-tasks, an optional `[ ]*` task, a Checkpoint, a task ticked before speccoder ran, steering with and without front matter.
- `photo-albums`: cc-sdd's style — `**Objective:**`, `WHEN … THEN the X SHALL`, `IF`, unindented sub-tasks, `(P)`, `_Depends:_`, free-text `_Requirements:_`, `spec.json`.
- `bugfix`: a bugfix spec (`bugfix.md`), which this version lists and does not run.
